answer: Proposal: a randomness beacon audits a fraction s of reward keys each epoch. An audited key must show a single-use token — verifier-issued, one per person per epoch, bound to that key and the beacon's challenge, appended to a glacier-cold write-once log so reuse fails — or forfeit deposit D. Unbiasable sampling hits clones at n·s audits per epoch, each needing its own person (stand-in wage w), so the cost ridge ≈ s·min(w, D) per clone per epoch — the line each clone's shrinking pool share must top to profit. Weak spots: verifier collusion or forged IDs mint tokens; honest keys bear audits.
